integrity_note: All statements and finite computations are independently defined and reproducible within the supplied files. The proof concerns the infinite family; finite checks alone do not prove it. No independent external validation or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to ordinary inclusion-minimal forts of J(n,2) for integer n >= 3. The minimum-fort size for n >= 5 is previously implied by the published Johnson-graph failed-zero-forcing number and is not treated as a new contribution. It does not classify all forts, all zero-forcing sets, or higher Johnson graphs. A related Johnson-graph source was accessible only through bibliographic metadata and an abstract; a stronger previously published equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: Minimal forts of triangular graphs: a cycle–star-forest classification
